facts.text: We had a mail chat with Gabriella sometimes in December last year.
The conversation was about The CommCare Community of Practice for Researchers inbox.
Gabriella Stoudemire said the Research Community of Practice would be officially launched on the CommCare Forum next month.
Gabriella Stoudemire said the Community of Practice would be a space for researchers to share ideas, collaborate, and troubleshoot.

I said I was doing very fine.

I said the Community of Practice would be very useful.
I said I would be very happy to be part of it and explore and interact with like minds in CommCare.
